title: Lamar Jackson: I told Tyler Loop his legacy was starting now

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lamar Jackson: I told Tyler Loop his legacy was starting now
sources.description: Ravens kicker Tyler Loop's missed field goal at the end of the final regular season game of the 2025 season kept Baltimore out of the playoffs and it was on the mind of many as Sunday's game against the Cowboys in Rio reached its final moments.
